title: The Long Ledger
author: Elodie Zhou
blurb: Freya Sterling, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
